blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — The Bohol provincial government has documented more than 1,400 individual plants of the critically endangered Bohol Helmet Orchid (Corybas boholensis) in an initial monitoring activity at the Loboc Watershed Forest Reserve in Bilar town.
